 🚨 Bordalás short-handed, LGP at full strength: Getafe -Sevilla line-ups 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Getafe and Sevilla kick off Sunday's LALIGA action with a clash that puts the home side under intense pressure at the Coliseum.
 After losing to Lebrijana in the Copa and sitting in the relegation zone, nothing but a win will do for Getafe. And Sevilla? A victory would put them three points off the Champions League places, currently occupied by Betis.
 OneFootball Videos
 Here are the confirmed line-ups for today's match in Getafe: 
 Getafe Sevilla 06:00 Getafe : Soria; Boselli, Valou, Djené, Carvajal, Andrés García ; Francho; Gudelj, Terrrats; Satriano and Enes Ünal . 
 ⚔️ Es ahora, Getafe 💥
#GetaOnce | #GetafeSevilla  –  Sunday, 1 November 2026 
 With Mojica and Mario Martín absent, along with the injured players, Boselli and Andrés come into the defence and Francho into midfield.
 Sevilla : Odysseas, Iglesias, Castrín, Kike Salas , Suazo, Agoumé, Fofana, Ejuke, Félix, Isaac and Stassin.
 🚨 Nuestro XI para enfrentarnos al @GetafeCF. ⚪️🔴
Odysseas, Iglesias, Castrín, Kike Salas, Suazo, Agoumé, Fofana, Ejuke, Félix, Isaac y Stassin.
#GetafeSevilla | #WeAreSevilla | #NuncaTeRindas  –  Sunday, 1 November 2026 
 Kike Salas, Suazo, Agoumé and Stassin return after being rested in the Copa.
